# Sankalp Chaturvedi

> Personal portfolio and dev log of Sankalp Chaturvedi — a software developer
> building Python/FastAPI backends, Elasticsearch/Kibana data pipelines, and
> agentic AI systems. The site is styled as a retro arcade game; the content
> underneath is a normal engineering portfolio.

Sankalp Chaturvedi is a Software Developer at Photonmatters (Aug 2025 –
present), working on lending infrastructure: he built the Python analytics
service behind a bank statement analyzer for loan underwriting (OCR-extracted
statements parsed, classified, and scored, with a human validation gate), cut
LLM cost with a persisted merchant dictionary, built an async campaign
messaging pipeline that has delivered 221K messages in a single run under
DND/quiet-hour/cap rules, is designing a multi-agent voice collections system
(FastAPI, LangGraph, Twilio/LiveKit) with a compliance guard on every branch,
and owns the month-end close for a mobile-lending portfolio — Python/FastAPI
and Elasticsearch pipelines over 10M+ loan events, including automated
TransUnion CRB regulatory submissions. Reconciliation variance holds within
±1.2% of bank movement. Previously: Fullstack Developer Intern at Dozti
(React, Node/Express, Docker) and ERP Developer Intern at Knighthood
(ERPNext/Frappe).

Skills: Python, JavaScript, SQL; LLM integration, agentic workflows,
LangGraph, RAG, embeddings, OCR, voice agents, Azure AI Foundry; BM25,
HNSW/ANN, hybrid retrieval (RRF), vector databases, Elasticsearch; FastAPI,
Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Docker, Git; React, Next.js.

Achievements: Smart India Hackathon national top-5 grand finalist (2023),
MetaByte Hackathon global rank 2 (2023), Flipkart GRiD 5.0 top 10% of
~400,000 participants (2023).

## Pages

- [Home](https://snklp.dev/): experience, projects, skills, achievements, contact
- [Dev Log](https://snklp.dev/blog): blog — research notes on backend

- [RSS feed](https://snklp.dev/rss.xml)

## Projects

- [Mini Search — hybrid retrieval engine](https://github.com/sankalp021/mini-search):
  search engine written from scratch in Python (core imports only numpy):
  hand-rolled BM25 inverted index, HNSW graph, reciprocal rank fusion, and
  CRC32C-checksummed on-disk segments; recall verified against FAISS across
  328 tests. Headline finding: on BEIR NFCorpus, exact brute force is ~11×
  faster than the HNSW graph at statistically identical quality.
- [AI Travel Itinerary Generator](https://github.com/sankalp021/travel-app):
  Next.js + Gemini API travel planner generating day-wise itineraries with
  budgets, stays, and a trip-context chatbot. Live at
  https://backpacker-compass.vercel.app
- [Byte Newz](https://github.com/sankalp021/newsapp): AI news aggregator that
  categorizes multi-source news in real time and serves 100-word AI
  summaries. Live at https://newsapp-ivory-six.vercel.app
